title: Kestrel and the Verdict
author: Lior Ishikawa
blurb: Noor Nystrom, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
